build_Fast3R_model: build a Fast3R model with croco encoder, fast3r decoder, and dpt head for image-to-3d reconstruction
run_Fast3R_forward: run the Fast3R forward pass on a list of view dicts to get 3D point predictions
load_Fast3R_from_dust3r_checkpoint: load a Dust3R checkpoint into a Fast3R model to initialize encoder and head weights
build_CroCoEncoder: build a CroCoEncoder with RoPE positional embeddings and configurable transformer blocks for image encoding
build_LlamaDecoder: build a LlamaDecoder with precomputed freqs_cis and view0 embedding for object-centric 3D decoding
